payload.body:
Last 7 days in dk-forge/talent-intelligence-tracker: 398 completed runs, 6 failed across 5 cause(s), 1 repeat red(s), 0 zero-job eviction(s).

A repeat red is a run that went red for a cause an earlier run
already reported. The first red of each cause is signal, was
already emailed once by the CI alerter, and is not counted here.

  drain-writers: 2 run(s) — 1 repeat red(s)
      cause: reconcile step above, or run: python writer_queue.py status
  collect national press: 1 run(s) — reported once, correctly
      cause: filtered Omusati father arrested after son’s fatal stabbing (no employment, site or work-policy term)
  backfill-gdelt-2026: 1 run(s) — reported once, correctly
      cause: [backfill-gdelt-<N>.yml] gate labels: <N> decision(s) recorded for the classifier training set (data/gate_labels/)
  tripwire: 1 run(s) — reported once, correctly
      cause: STOPPING: spend ceiling reached. Collection will not run.
  collect: 1 run(s) — reported once, correctly
      cause: ##[endgroup]

Noise means a structural fix regressed or is missing; the fix
is never to silence the run. See drain-writers red-once and
the schedule-eviction auto-resolve in writer_queue.py.
payload.subject: CI noise, week 2026-w32: 1 noisy run(s) in talent-intelligence-tracker

entries.repaired_because: key ci-noise:2026-W32 was rejected 400 'bad dedupe_key' 16 times: /alert accepts ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9:._-]{0,159}$ and the ISO week carried an uppercase W. Rewritten to ci-noise:2026-w32; ci_noise_report.py now composes %G-w%V. Attempts zeroed because this is a different, deliverable key, and leaving it past FAIL_LOUD_ATTEMPTS would keep host-watch red on an alert that is about to succeed.
